metadata.description: Wire format shared by the JSON liveness and readiness responses (`GET /healthz`, `GET /readyz`). Source of truth for the writer: `crates/vibe-index/src/server/routes/health.rs` (`Health`, `healthz`, `readyz`); the generated reader lives in `crates/vibe-wire/src/generated/index_http/e1/health_response/`.
The probe verdict: `ok` from the liveness route or `ready` from the readiness route.
The registry name held by the in-memory index at probe time.
The two probe states the server implements. Closed because each value names one concrete handler, not an extensible external register.
